disclosure: All records are synthetic and generated deterministically.
purpose: Representative source-system exports used to demonstrate the production ingestion path.

sources.name: Vendor claim manifest
sources.production_method: SFTP, object storage, or invoice API
sources.trust_boundary: Declares what the vendor wants to bill; it does not determine payability.

sources.name: Vendor agent execution log
sources.production_method: Vendor API, webhook, or signed object-store delivery
sources.trust_boundary: Useful supporting evidence, but never a customer system of record.

sources.name: Customer support desk
sources.production_method: Read-only OAuth API, warehouse view, or scheduled export
sources.trust_boundary: Customer-owned evidence is not visible or editable by the vendor.

sources.name: Payment processor
sources.trust_boundary: Authoritative for payment state; Evidue receives read-only access.

sources.name: Product operations ledger
sources.production_method: Read-only Snowflake, BigQuery, or Redshift view
sources.trust_boundary: Read-only customer data; only approved columns are exposed.

sources.name: Billing and attribution ledger
sources.production_method: Warehouse view, SFTP, or billing API
sources.trust_boundary: Customer-owned billing history is independent of the current vendor invoice.

sources.name: Customer identity map
sources.trust_boundary: Used only to join approved identifiers; raw PII is not required for the demo.

sources.name: Contract documents
sources.production_method: Secure upload plus approved rule versioning
sources.trust_boundary: AI may extract candidate rules, but a customer approver activates each version.
